breakdown.description: The prompt collapses the distributed self-weight into a single end load and calls it exact, even though the axial force from self-weight varies continuously along the bar.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification removes the incorrect instruction to replace distributed self-weight with a single concentrated end load as an 'exact' force. Instead, it correctly uses the varying axial force expression P(x) = ρ g A (L − x) and the integral δ = ∫₀ᴸ P(x)/(A E) dx, matching the ground truth treatment.
